dict.string: Independent project; not affiliated with Apple or Samsung.
Tab2Mac finds your tablet over Bluetooth to connect directly, without a router, when you ask it to.
macOS requires Location access to see and join Wi‑Fi networks. Tab2Mac uses it only to join your tablet's own network when you connect directly, and to return to your previous network.
